name: Cards & Consumer Lending
description: Credit cards, personal loans, and auto loans: balances, spend, yield, delinquency, and losses.

dimensions.name: score_band
dimensions.description: Credit score band at origination or refresh

metrics.name: outstanding_balance
metrics.description: Receivables outstanding at a point in time

metrics.name: purchase_volume
metrics.description: Card purchase volume in the period

metrics.name: net_charge_offs
metrics.description: Gross charge-offs minus recoveries in the period

metrics.name: nco_rate
metrics.description: Annualized net charge-offs divided by average receivables

metrics.name: delinquency_rate_30_plus
metrics.description: Balances 30+ days past due divided by total balances

metrics.name: portfolio_yield
metrics.description: Annualized finance charges and fees divided by average receivables

conventions.rule: Loss and yield rates are annualized from the period; state the annualization factor.
Net charge-offs are net of recoveries; report gross and recoveries separately when asked.
Compare vintages at equal months-on-book, not on calendar date.

insight_rules.reason: Rates are not additive across segments; decompose the numerator and denominator instead.

caveats.text: Card spend and delinquency are seasonal (holiday spend, tax refunds); compare to the same period a year earlier.
Segmenting by credit characteristics can proxy protected attributes; route consumer-decision uses through fair-lending review.

chart_conventions.rule: Show vintage loss curves with months-on-book on the x-axis and one line per vintage.

review.notes: Drafted from public, general industry conventions; not yet reviewed by a named domain owner.
